title: Unitree G1 EDU root-RCE control-plane disclosures
affected: Unitree G1 EDU firmware through 1.5.2 per published CVE records

behaviors: path traversal into privileged execution path

interpretation: Behavioral/architectural indicators only. Component names or port presence alone are not evidence of compromise.
propagation_note: Research demonstrated attack reach between nearby G1 robots, but the July 2026 cloud authorization fix breaks the exact published cross-owner proof-of-concept flow. Do not label current firmware autonomously wormable without new evidence.
